summary: Evaxion A/S filed a Form 6-K on July 13, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing new preclinical data for its cytomegalovirus (CMV) vaccine program EVX-V1, presented at a scientific conference. The filing is a routine disclosure of scientific progress and does not involve any corporate transaction, shareholder action, or structural change. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or special-situation mechanics present. As a foreign private issuer's report of clinical data, this filing does not constitute a special situation under the defined categories.
